build_scraper: build the google-maps-scraper binary from the extracted Go source directory
run_scraper_with_args: run the google-maps-scraper binary with custom arguments and a timeout
unzip_file: unzip a google-maps-scraper archive from a remote URL into the current directory
set_email_for_website: extract an email address from a website and append it to a CSV row
start: start the full outreach pipeline: scrape businesses, extract emails, and send emails
